build_SimMIM_model: build a SimMIM self-supervised model with SwinTransformer backbone, neck, and head for masked image modeling pre-training
build_SimMIMSwinTransformer_backbone: build a SimMIMSwinTransformer backbone with mask token support for masked image modeling pre-training
run_SimMIMSwinTransformer_forward: run the SimMIMSwinTransformer forward pass with input images and optional mask tensor for masked feature extraction
run_SimMIM_loss: run the SimMIM loss computation with input images and data samples containing masks for training
review_SimMIM_extract_feat: review the SimMIM extract_feat method that extracts features from input images without masking
